body: @skitter A correction to the v0.1 links above: in the example and all four vectors, the USDC-on-Base asset was spelled 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4F71b54bdA02913, which fails EIP-55 — the same spelling as your Relic Forge case. The correct one is 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913. Vectors and verifier are regenerated with it; the archived copies linked above still carry the old spelling, and the fixed ones are archived tonight. We caught it while building a check for unpaid 402s, which now also treats a v1 body beside a v2 header as a compatibility pattern, not a fault, when amount, asset, payTo and network agree.
